description: This file defines the 'Png' class responsible for representing and loading PNG image data within the PDFsharp library. It includes methods to open PNG images from streams, byte arrays, and files, and provides properties to access image metadata like dimensions and transparency.

classes.name: Png
classes.description: Represents a PNG image, providing methods to load and access image data and metadata.

methods.name: GetPixelIndex
methods.description: Returns the palette index at the specified (x, y) coordinate.

methods.name: GetPalette
methods.description: Retrieves the color palette of the PNG image.

methods.name: GetPixel
methods.description: Returns the pixel data at the specified (x, y) coordinate.

methods.name: Open (Stream, IChunkVisitor?)
methods.description: Loads a PNG image from a stream with an optional chunk visitor.

methods.name: Open (Stream, PngOpenerSettings)
methods.description: Loads a PNG image from a stream with specified settings.

methods.name: Open (byte[], IChunkVisitor?)
methods.description: Loads a PNG image from a byte array with an optional chunk visitor.

methods.name: Open (byte[], PngOpenerSettings)
methods.description: Loads a PNG image from a byte array with specified settings.

methods.name: Open (string, IChunkVisitor?)
methods.description: Loads a PNG image from a file path with an optional chunk visitor.

methods.name: Open (string, PngOpenerSettings)
methods.description: Loads a PNG image from a file path with specified settings.
